item.title: IMaSS Network 2023 - RePAIR Project
item.description: On 26 June 2023 Dr. Arianna Traviglia of the Center for Cultural Heritage Technology (CCHT) participated in a keynote speech at the IMASS conference entitled: "The light fantastic. Exploring the magic of light in understanding Cultural Heritage"

item.title: AIRPA VI - Pictura Parietum - Connessioni Mediterranee in Età Ellenistica e Romana - RePAIR Project
item.description: At the Archaeological Park of Agrigento from 6 to 8 July 2023, the Archaeological Park of Pompeii partecipated in a conference on ancient painting organized by AIRPA - Associazione Italiana Ricerche Pittura Antica.

item.title: International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2023 - RePAIR Project
item.description: On October 3rd, Sinem Aslan, Assistant Professor at the Department of Environmental Sciences, Informatics and Statistics at Ca’ Foscari University of Venice, Italy, presented the work Semantic Motif Segmentation of Archeological Fresco Fragments at the International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2023 in Paris, France.

item.title: Informatici Senza Frontiere Festival - RePAIR Project
item.description: On October 20, Sebastiano Vascon, Assistant Professor in Computer Science at the Department of Environmental Sciences, Informatics and Statistics at Ca’ Foscari University of Venice, was a guest speaker at the Informatici senza frontiere festival in Rovereto (Trento, Italy) for the meeting "Digital, Culture and Accessibility" in which he spoke about the RePair project.
